say:0:1422301001:0.text: Magister, there's a dwarf over there who seems upset...
say:0:1422301001:0.source_cn: 主人，那边好像有矮人在苦恼着什么……
say:0:1422301001:0.male: Magister, there's a dwarf over there who seems upset...
say:0:1422301001:0.female: Magister, there's a dwarf over there who seems upset...

say:2:1422302001:1.text: Hello, sir. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?
say:2:1422302001:1.male: Hello, sir. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?
say:2:1422302001:1.female: Hello, miss. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?

say:3:1422302002:1.text: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?
say:3:1422302002:1.source_cn: 能不能回村里帮我看看，我的妻子和女儿过得好不好……
say:3:1422302002:1.male: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?
say:3:1422302002:1.female: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?

say:4:1422302003:1.text: Aren't you originally from this village? Why don't you do it yourself instead of asking strangers to help you?
say:4:1422302003:1.source_cn: 诶？你原本就是这个村子的人吗？为什么要找陌生人去看呢？

say:5:1422302004:1.text: Because I don't want the villagers to know I'm back... Oh, don't get me wrong! I haven't done anything wrong!
say:5:1422302004:1.source_cn: 因为我不想让村里的人知道我回来了……别误会！我没干过什...

say:6:1422302005:1.text: It's just that I can't bear for them to see me... I can't face Freda and Tali...
say:6:1422302005:1.source_cn: 我只是没脸见人……我该怎么面对弗瑞达和塔莉……

say:7:1422302006:1.text: My name is Harge, and I'm a blacksmith. Three years ago, I left home and promised to make a lot of money, become famous, build a grand workshop, and then return home...
say:7:1422302006:1.source_cn: 我叫哈尔格，是个铁匠。三年前，我从家里出来的时候满口承...

say:8:1422302007:1.text: Freda and Tali were very supportive. They never wrote about their struggles at home in their letters, but I knew how tough life was for them here.
say:8:1422302007:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达和塔莉很支持我，虽然她们在信里从不说家里的困难，...

say:9:1422302008:1.text: In the end, I never earned a single copper, and I've come back empty-handed.
say:9:1422302008:1.source_cn: 结果我呢，一个子没赚到，兜里空空的就这样回来了！

say:10:1422302009:1.source_cn: 你不是说你的手艺很好吗？

say:11:1422302010:1.text: Well, yes and no. I went to Rustport first, and in the beginning, business was good, but later, the port closed. Everything became more expensive, and finally, my money ran out...
say:11:1422302010:1.source_cn: 我先去了锈锚港，刚开始生意还不错，可后来港口封闭了，所...

say:12:1422302011:1.text: After the port reopened, I went to Cedartown to join up with some friends who worked there, but everyone there was always working on those ice sculptures. No one was interested in my smithing skills.
say:12:1422302011:1.source_cn: 港口解封后，我又去了雪松镇，想投奔在那干活的朋友，可那...

say:15:1422302012:1.text: Every time you went somewhere, it didn't work out...
say:15:1422302012:1.source_cn: 每次都刚好去了不适合做生意的地方呢……

say:16:1422302013:1.text: Now that I'm back home, I can't face them. How can I show my face around here? I'm just a useless idiot!
say:16:1422302013:1.source_cn: 可能我就是这么没用吧！如今回到村里我都不敢面对她们……...

say:19:1422302014:1.text: Chippy gets how you feel... Your wife's name is Freda, right? We'll go visit her for you!
say:19:1422302014:1.source_cn: 满满了解你的心情了……你的妻子叫弗瑞达是吗？我们会替你...

say:20:1422302015:1.text: Oh, thank you! My house is east of the village. I hope they're doing well...
say:20:1422302015:1.source_cn: 太感谢了！我家在村子东边，希望她们一切都好……

say:0:1422303001:0.text: Is Harge's house around here? Let's ask around.
say:0:1422303001:0.source_cn: 哈尔格的家是在这附近吗？我们问问周围的人吧！

say:4:1422304002:1.text: Oh, a hamster! No, two hamsters, and they're super fluffy! So cute! Almost as cute as my little lamb!
say:4:1422304002:1.source_cn: 呀，小仓鼠！毛绒绒的有两只呢……真可爱！和我的小羊一样可爱！

say:5:1422304003:1.text: Are you mages visiting the village?
say:5:1422304003:1.source_cn: 你们就是来村里访问的魔法师吗？
say:5:1422304003:1.male: Are you mages visiting the village?
say:5:1422304003:1.female: Are you mages visiting the village?

say:6:1422304004:1.text: Oh, thanks for calling us cute... Our magister is a mage, and I can cast magic too... Hey! Please don't touch my ears!
say:6:1422304004:1.source_cn: 呃……谢谢……我们的主人是魔法师，我们俩是魔法使魔……...
say:6:1422304004:1.male: Oh, thanks for calling us cute... Our magister is a mage, and I can cast magic too... Hey! Please don't touch my ears!
say:6:1422304004:1.female: Oh, thanks for calling us cute... Our magister is a mage, and I can cast magic too... Hey! Please don't touch my ears!

say:7:1422304005:1.text: Ah, don't pinch Chippy's cheeks! What if they get lopsided?! Hey, look at me! Do you know where Freda's house is?
say:7:1422304005:1.source_cn: 也别捏满满的脸颊肉！我们想问，你知道弗瑞达家在哪吗？

say:8:1422304006:1.text: Of course, I know where it is! Freda's my mother! So, you're looking for my house then?
say:8:1422304006:1.source_cn: 当然知道，弗瑞达是我的妈妈！欸，所以你们要找的是我家吗？

say:10:1422304008:1.text: Yes, you know who I am? What do you want with my mother?
say:10:1422304008:1.source_cn: 是的，原来你们认识我！你们找我妈妈有什么事吗？

say:11:1422304009:1.text: It's not a big deal actually. We just want to ask her some questions...
say:11:1422304009:1.source_cn: 其实也没什么大事，只是想问一些问题……

say:12:1422304010:1.text: For example, how have you two been lately? Any trouble?
say:12:1422304010:1.source_cn: 比如说……你们最近过得好吗，有没有什么烦恼之类的？

say:13:1422304011:1.text: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?
say:13:1422304011:1.source_cn: 好新鲜，魔法师竟然会问我这些！
say:13:1422304011:1.male: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?
say:13:1422304011:1.female: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?

choice_prompt:14:1422304011.text: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?
choice_prompt:14:1422304011.source_cn: 好新鲜，魔法师竟然会问我这些！
choice_prompt:14:1422304011.male: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?
choice_prompt:14:1422304011.female: That's funny. Why would a mage care about that?

say:15:1422304012:1.text: Well, if you ask my mother directly, she won't answer you, but I know what she's worried about.
say:15:1422304012:1.source_cn: 烦恼嘛……如果你们直接去问妈妈，她不会说什么的，但我知...

say:16:1422304013:1.text: The turkeys that we raised at home ran away to the other side of the hills. My mother has been worried about them.
say:16:1422304013:1.source_cn: 最近家里养了好久的火鸡跑掉了，跑到了远处的山坡上，妈妈...

say:17:1422304014:0.text: They used to listen to my father, but now they just run away whenever I get close to them.
say:17:1422304014:0.source_cn: 它们之前很听爸爸的话，可现在我一靠近它们，它们就跑！

say:18:1422304015:1.source_cn: 我们愿意帮你把火鸡赶回来！

say:19:1422304016:0.text: No way! Mages really are the best!

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 因为我是乐于助人的魔法师

choice:14:1:2.text: I don't want kids to be in trouble.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 因为魔法师不希望小孩子有烦恼
choice:14:1:2.male: I don't want kids to be in trouble.
choice:14:1:2.female: I don't want kids to be in trouble.

say:1:1422305001:1.text: All the turkeys are back! Let's go find my mother!
say:1:1422305001:1.source_cn: 火鸡都回来啦！我带你们去找妈妈！

say:2:1422305002:1.text: She'll definitely want to hear the good news!
say:2:1422305002:1.source_cn: 妈妈知道这个好消息一定会很开心的！

say:1:1422306001:1.text: Mother! Some people are here to see us!
say:1:1422306001:1.source_cn: 妈妈，有魔法师和仓鼠使魔来看我们了！
say:1:1422306001:1.male: Mother! Some people are here to see us!
say:1:1422306001:1.female: Mother! Some people are here to see us!

say:2:1422306002:1.source_cn: 他们还帮我们把火鸡赶了回来！

say:3:1422306003:1.text: Tali... Oh, they really are back!
say:3:1422306003:1.source_cn: 塔莉……你又……哎，火鸡真的飞回来了！

say:4:1422306004:1.text: So, you're Tali's guests... Apologies, I thought it was one of Tali's fantasies again...
say:4:1422306004:1.source_cn: 你们就是塔莉说的……客人？抱歉，我还以为塔莉又在幻想……

say:5:1422306005:1.text: Children always say fantastical things like how little lambs and hamsters could talk...
say:5:1422306005:1.source_cn: 小孩子嘛，总会说一些不切实际的话，比如小羊和仓鼠会说话...

say:7:1422306006:1.text: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!
say:7:1422306006:1.source_cn: 这次塔莉可没说错，你们确实遇到了好心的魔法师！
say:7:1422306006:1.male: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!
say:7:1422306006:1.female: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!

say:8:1422306007:1.source_cn: 这……！我今天是不是睡昏头了……

say:9:1422306008:1.text: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.
say:9:1422306008:1.source_cn: ……是这样的，我们的主人是隶属魔法师协会的魔法师，只有...
say:9:1422306008:1.male: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.
say:9:1422306008:1.female: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.

say:10:1422306009:1.text: Just like what we did for you, Freda!
say:10:1422306009:1.source_cn: 所以我们需要帮助别人解决烦恼，比如弗瑞达你的！

say:11:1422306010:1.text: How do you know my name?

say:12:1422306011:1.source_cn: 这个……是魔法！……很神奇的魔法！

choice_prompt:13:1422306011.source_cn: 这个……是魔法！……很神奇的魔法！

say:14:1422306012:1.text: Well, it's rare that someone has the time to listen to my troubles. I don't worry much about anything except for... Tali's father.
say:14:1422306012:1.source_cn: ……好吧，真难得有人愿意听我的烦恼。我没别的烦恼，唯独...

say:15:1422306013:1.text: He left the village to find work, and I know how hard he pushes himself. It must be so difficult for him out there. I always make sure to send him letters, letting him know we were okay, and he'd reply as quickly as he could.
say:15:1422306013:1.source_cn: 塔莉的父亲去了村外打拼，工作得废寝忘食，十分辛苦，但我...

say:16:1422306014:1.text: But recently, he hasn't been responding. I'm worried that something happened to him.
say:16:1422306014:1.source_cn: 可我最近寄给他的信，连着几封都没有回音，我担心……他出...

say:18:1422306016:1.text: Apologies if I've said too much... I just wrote a new letter. It'd be great if you can help me deliver it to him. I still need to prepare dinner...
say:18:1422306016:1.source_cn: 抱歉对着你们说了这么多……我刚写了一封新的信想寄给他，...

say:19:1422306017:1.text: Oh, as a thank you, how about we have dinner together tonight? I'll prepare a hearty meal!
say:19:1422306017:1.source_cn: 作为感谢，我邀请你们今晚一起吃晚餐吧，我会准备一顿丰盛...

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 塔莉跟我们提到了你的名字

say:0:1422307001:0.text: Let's give this letter directly to Harge!
say:0:1422307001:0.source_cn: 我们把信直接交给哈尔格吧！

say:4:1422308002:1.text: Freda and Tali seem to be doing fine. We even helped them gather their lost turkeys!
say:4:1422308002:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达和塔莉看上去一切都好，我们还帮她们赶回了跑掉的火鸡！

say:5:1422308003:1.text: However, Freda is worried about you. She said that you haven't been returning her letters and asked us to deliver her latest one.
say:5:1422308003:1.source_cn: 不过弗瑞达看起来很担心你的样子，她说最近寄给你的信没有...

say:6:1422308004:1.text: I was probably already on my way home when she sent the others. Let me take a look at her latest letter!
say:6:1422308004:1.source_cn: 那些信到的时候，我已经在回家的路上了……我想看看那封新的信！

say:3:1422309001:1.text: Freda... I'm a terrible husband and father...
say:3:1422309001:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达……我不是一个称职的丈夫和父亲……

say:4:1422309002:1.text: But Freda didn't even blame you for anything.
say:4:1422309002:1.source_cn: 可是弗瑞达并没有埋怨你呀？

say:5:1422309003:1.text: I've only ever thought about my own goals and feelings! Even now, standing at the doorstep of my home, I can't let go of my pride and face them!
say:5:1422309003:1.source_cn: 一直以来我只考虑自己的抱负和心情，就像现在，哪怕在家门...

say:6:1422309004:1.text: I caused them so much needless worry. They never cared about wealth or fame—all they ever wanted was for me to be by their side...
say:6:1422309004:1.source_cn: 我让她们增加了那么多无谓的担心，却从没想过，她们需要的...

say:7:1422309005:1.source_cn: 我决定了，我要回家见她们！

say:8:1422309006:1.text: That's great that you've finally figured it out! They will be so happy to see you!
say:8:1422309006:1.source_cn: 你能想通真是太好啦！她们见到你一定会很高兴的。

say:9:1422309007:1.text: Freda invited us to dinner tonight and said she would prepare a hearty meal for everyone.
say:9:1422309007:1.source_cn: 刚好今天晚上弗瑞达邀请我们去吃晚饭，她说会准备一顿丰盛...

say:10:1422309008:1.text: If you show up at dinner, it'll be a wonderful surprise!
say:10:1422309008:1.source_cn: 如果在晚餐时分哈尔格突然出现，她们一定会很惊喜！

say:11:1422309009:0.text: Before I go, I need to prepare something. I actually got them a gift, a lute I made myself.
say:11:1422309009:0.source_cn: 在见她们之前，我还想准备一些东西……其实，我给弗瑞达和...

say:12:1422309010:1.text: But I didn't prepare any wrapping paper or anything...
say:12:1422309010:1.source_cn: 我想把礼物亲手交到她们手上，但我还没来得及准备包装……

say:13:1422309011:1.text: We can use flowers! The brighter, the better! Come on, let's go pick some and make your gift look amazing!
say:13:1422309011:1.source_cn: 最好的包装就是鲜艳的花朵，我们去采点花装饰一下礼物吧！...

say:2:1422310001:1.text: Thank you! I'll use these beautiful flowers to decorate the gift!
say:2:1422310001:1.source_cn: 感谢你们！我来把这些美丽的花装饰在礼物上！

say:3:1422310002:1.text: We'll wait for you to finish up, and then we can all go enjoy a big meal together!
say:3:1422310002:1.source_cn: 我们等你装饰好，一起去吃大餐！

say:0:1422311001:0.text: It's about dinner time. Let's go to your house!
say:0:1422311001:0.source_cn: 时间到了，一起去吃晚饭吧！

say:0:1422312001:0.text: We were waiting for you... What?! Father?!
say:0:1422312001:0.source_cn: 魔法师，你们来啦！啊！那是爸爸！
say:0:1422312001:0.male: We were waiting for you... What?! Father?!
say:0:1422312001:0.female: We were waiting for you... What?! Father?!

say:1:1422313001:1.text: Freda, we've brought you a surprise! Look! Harge is back!
say:1:1422313001:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达，我们来啦！我们给你带来了惊喜。看！哈尔格回来啦！

say:2:1422313002:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达看上去一副意料之中的样子呢。

say:3:1422313003:1.text: Well, when Harge didn't reply to my letters, I guessed that he might be on his way home. After all, he would always write and tell me his new address every time he changed cities.
say:3:1422313003:1.source_cn: 其实，从哈尔格没有回信开始，我就猜到他或许在回家的路上...

say:4:1422313004:1.text: And then, out of nowhere, kind strangers showed up at my door to help me and Tali. It was almost as if someone had sent them...
say:4:1422313004:1.source_cn: 再加上突然有好心的陌生人帮助我和塔莉，像是受人所托的样子……

say:5:1422313005:1.text: What? Was Chippy's acting not enough? Did we look suspicious to you?
say:5:1422313005:1.source_cn: 唔……！满满演得不像好心的魔法使魔吗！我们难道看起来很...

say:7:1422313006:1.text: No, Chippy, you're the best! You've brought my father home!
say:7:1422313006:1.source_cn: 满满是好心的魔法使魔！你还帮我带回了爸爸！

say:9:1422313007:1.text: Tali, you're so big now! Freda... I...
say:9:1422313007:1.source_cn: 塔莉，你长高了！弗瑞达……我……

say:11:1422313008:1.text: Harge, all that matters is that you're back with us...
say:11:1422313008:1.source_cn: 哈尔格，不管怎样，你回来就好……

say:12:1422313009:1.text: Harge has been preparing to come home for a while. He even brought a gift!
say:12:1422313009:1.source_cn: 哈尔格为回家准备了很久，他还给你们带了礼物呢！

say:13:1422313010:1.text: I made this lute myself... Tali, I know you can't play yet, but I will teach you.
say:13:1422313010:1.source_cn: 是我亲手做的鲁特琴……塔莉，爸爸知道你还不会弹奏它，以...

say:15:1422313011:1.text: Wow! It's so beautiful! Look at all the flowers! I will definitely do my best to learn!
say:15:1422313011:1.source_cn: 好漂亮的礼物，被鲜花装饰着呢！塔莉会好好学怎么弹琴的！

say:16:1422313012:1.text: Alright, everyone, don't just stand there. It's time to eat, sing, and dance! Let's show these guests what a real dwarven party looks like!
say:16:1422313012:1.source_cn: 好啦朋友们，别傻站着啦，我们来唱歌，跳舞，享用美食！让...

say:17:1422313013:1.text: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!
say:17:1422313013:1.source_cn: 魔法师朋友，来为我们弹奏一曲吧！
say:17:1422313013:1.male: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!
say:17:1422313013:1.female: Ah, my mage friend, come play a song for us!

narration:0:1422314001:1.text: After the party, the following morning...

say:2:1422314002:1.text: Good morning, my mage friend. I am here to say goodbye to you and your familiars.
say:2:1422314002:1.male: Good morning, my mage friend. I am here to say goodbye to you and your familiars.
say:2:1422314002:1.female: Good morning, my mage friend. I am here to say goodbye to you and your familiars.

say:4:1422314003:1.text: What? You just got home! Are you leaving already?
say:4:1422314003:1.source_cn: 欸？！你刚回家，这么快就要走了吗！

say:5:1422314004:1.text: Yes, but this time it's going to be the three of us going together.
say:5:1422314004:1.source_cn: 是的，不过这次是我和弗瑞达、塔莉，我们三个一起走。

say:7:1422314005:1.text: After a long talk last night, we decided that this was the best for us. Between my smelting and Harge's forging skills, I know we can make a name for ourselves.
say:7:1422314005:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上我们聊了很多，最后做出了这个决定。我想凭我的冶...

say:8:1422314006:1.text: In the future, even if we encounter a tough situation, we'll face it together as a family.
say:8:1422314006:1.source_cn: 以后哪怕遇到什么困难，也是我们三个一起面对了。

say:10:1422314007:1.text: I really want to explore the world outside and learn how to smelt, forge, and play instruments like my parents do.
say:10:1422314007:1.source_cn: 塔莉也想见识外面的世界，跟爸爸妈妈学冶炼、锻造和弹奏乐器！

say:11:1422314008:1.text: Promise me we'll meet again out there in the big old world!
say:11:1422314008:1.source_cn: 好心的魔法师和魔法使魔，我们一定会在外面的世界再见的！
say:11:1422314008:1.male: Promise me we'll meet again out there in the big old world!
say:11:1422314008:1.female: Promise me we'll meet again out there in the big old world!
